home.title: ILSA Labs | Gen 2 Intelligence + Living Systems
home.description: ILSA Labs is an Australian human technology lab building advanced technology across human state, identity, neurodevelopment, health, interaction and living systems.

platforms.name: OTON\OMY
platforms.title: OTON\OMY | Human State Intelligence | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: OTON/OMY brings body, mind and technology into one continuous conversation. It reads sleep, movement, recovery and response in real time, not as another dashboard of numbers.

platforms.name: 37T
platforms.title: 37T | Identity & Likeness Infrastructure | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: 37T is permission infrastructure for identity and creative work in the AI economy. Face, voice and work, verified, licensed and paid.

platforms.name: teo
platforms.title: teo | Mediated Intelligence | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: teo sits between two people and helps them have the conversation they have been meaning to have. It listens to both sides and keeps it safe.

platforms.name: Aston
platforms.title: Aston | Neurodevelopmental Intelligence | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: Aston is a screening instrument for observable neurodivergence. Parent, teacher and clinician. One clear picture of the child. Not a diagnosis.

platforms.name: Texlex
platforms.title: Texlex | Neurodevelopmental Intelligence | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: Texlex writes the neurodevelopmental report in the clinician's voice. The clinician stays the author. Beta preview. No public site yet.

platforms.name: InnerLayer
platforms.title: InnerLayer | Conversation Intelligence | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: InnerLayer is decision intelligence for live conversation. It reads what is happening underneath the words. Beta preview. No public site yet.

platforms.name: Reeboot AI
platforms.title: Reeboot AI | Adaptive Mental Health | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: Reeboot AI is adaptive mental health technology in the ILSA Labs human-technology graph. Founded in Perth, Western Australia.

platforms.name: Leeve AI
platforms.title: Leeve AI | Workforce Health Infrastructure | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: Leeve AI is workforce health infrastructure in the ILSA Labs human-technology graph.

platforms.name: Anima
platforms.title: Anima | Living Systems Technology | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: Anima Lab develops plant-derived therapeutics for the animals we live with. Evidence-led, formulated in Australia.

platforms.name: Humantech
platforms.title: Humantech | Human Performance | ILSA Labs
platforms.description: Humantech is human performance research at ILSA Labs. Sleep, cognition, recovery, longevity. The lab turned on ourselves.
